trackingLinkDomain.comment: Optional dedicated short-link origin (e.g. https://mstx.to). Used to render TrackingLink.shortUrl and by the mint endpoint. The edge must route GET {trackingLinkDomain}/{slug} to /api/v1/TrackingLink/go/{slug} and NOTHING else (keeps the CRM origin out of public links - phishing/blocklist blast-radius isolation). Empty = fall back to {siteUrl}/api/v1/TrackingLink/go/{slug}.
